objective: Resolve every HIGH and MEDIUM finding from the 2026-09-08 CI/CD red-team report with tested, fail-closed controls.
scope: H1 exact-PR-head trusted OPA check and required-check wiring
H3 deploy-time signature, provenance, SBOM, and SCA admission
H4 private service endpoint DAST coverage
M1 release eligibility and protected tag creation

authorizations.merge_and_scoped_security_configuration: coordinate through primary owner before mutation

success_criteria: A trusted workflow publishes a fail-closed check on the exact pull-request head SHA without executing untrusted code under a write token
Gitleaks evaluates repository history in protected branch and release contexts
Only security-eligible source revisions can create release tags
GitOps promotion verifies signature, provenance, SBOM SCA, and actual private service DAST
Every Checkov finding is fixed or mapped to a current bounded exception
All relevant negative tests and live non-production checks pass
escalation_trigger: Any release publication, protection weakening, secret access, or destructive production action stops for the primary owner.
